dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pi09](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pi09) Magnitude 6.2 earthquake at 49.452 depth occurred on Jan 05 2025 48km S of San Luis Talpa. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 13.053 longitude -89.1723. It impacted 138269 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
